biggest_catch: Both $20 rewards are discount codes for Pactimo gear, not cash — and your friend has to spend $99+ before either of you gets anything.
catches: Friend gets $20 off their FIRST order only, and only on orders of $99 or more.
Referrer gets $20 off their NEXT order — a discount code, not withdrawable cash.
Rewards are discount codes for use at Pactimo, not cash or general gift cards.
No cap or expiry publicly stated on the referral page.

c1.evidence: Pactimo — real cycling apparel brand; official pactimo.com refer-a-friend page.

c2.evidence: Official page titled 'Refer a Friend & Get Rewarded | Give $20 Get $20' states the per-side $20 rewards: $20 off the friend's first order of $99+ and $20 off the referrer's next order.

c3.evidence: Free to participate; no fee to share or use a referral link.

c4.evidence: Official page: 'Give $20, Get $20 — Share your unique referral link with family and friends and get rewards'; friend receives $20 off first order of $99+, referrer receives $20 off their next order.

eligibility: Friend must be a new customer placing their first Pactimo order of $99+ through your referral link. Rewards are Pactimo discount codes usable on Pactimo purchases only.
notes: Official referral page reviewed 2026-09-23. Reward is a fixed dollar discount ($20 each side) — the only caveat is that it is store credit rather than cash, which is disclosed. No Pactimo route exists in the catalog, so no duplication. Cap and expiry are not publicly stated on the page, so they are marked unspecified rather than guessed.
payout_quote: Official page: 'Give $20, Get $20.' Friend receives '$20 Off their first Order of $99+'; referrer receives '$20 Off your next order.'

s1.note: New customers only; friend must place a first order of $99+ through the referral link to trigger both rewards.

s2.note: Rewards are $20 Pactimo discount codes — fixed value, store-only, not cash; clearly disclosed.

s3.note: Rewards are issued after the friend's qualifying $99+ first order; no published expiry.

s4.note: 'Give $20, Get $20' stated flatly; no weasel words on the amounts.

s6.note: Steps are concrete: share link, friend orders $99+ first order, both get $20-off codes.

steps: Get your unique Pactimo referral link (share your Pactimo account's refer-a-friend link).
Share it with a friend or family member.
Your friend places their first Pactimo order of $99 or more through your link.
Your friend gets $20 off that order.
You get a $20-off code for your next Pactimo order.
timing: Referrer's $20 code issues after the friend's qualifying $99+ first order; exact processing time not published.
